sources.enabled: Whether the flight reports roll and total after the carry. Off leaves carry only, as before.
sources.lie: Landing surface of the roll: the fairway, the reference lie of the repository runout model (sg_optimizer.shot_model.ground_runout). A model assumption, never read from the scene.
sources.slope: Grade of the landing zone: flat, a bin of the repository slope vocabulary (slope_wind_bins.SLOPE_BINS). The tracer places the ball on level ground, so no slope is assumed.
sources.default_skill: Club class used when the export names no club: the driver, which is also the class of the flight's default spin envelope (flight_report.spin_envelope_reason).
sources.assumption: On-screen and manifest label of the roll: it is a model assumption, not a measurement or an engine contact result.
sources.hud_format: HUD line of the roll; {roll} and {total} are display-unit distance texts, {assumption} the label above.
